agentId.description: User-chosen agent name, unique in a project. 'user' and 'system' are reserved participants, not agents.

participant.description: Sender or recipient of a message.

role.description: general: the single agent of basic mode. head_logic / head_dispatch: the two heads of cluster mode. worker / guardian / investigator / compressor: cluster roles.

endpointId.description: Id of a user-configured model endpoint profile (schemas/config). Never contains a key or URL.
